votes.motion: Recommend that the Board of Selectmen approve the Financial Policies submitted by the Fin Comm.
votes.quote: terri b. moved that the committee recommend that the board of selectmen [bos] approve the financial policies submitted by the fin comm. karin m. seconded the motion. the committee approved the motion 4-0.
